results.description:
His one obsession is her…

From the moment Colette sweeps into my bar, I can’t stop watching her. Even when she doesn’t know I’m looking. Especially then.
My cameras record her every smile, every frown, every moment. I study her until I know my girl inside out, my obsession growing, overwhelming me, demanding I act.
She’ll never find out my secret, will she?

Mountain Man’s Obsession features an OTT obsessed mountain man and the curvy innocent woman he claims as his own. It’s high heat, oh so sweet, and always with a happily ever after.

The Men of Maple Mountain series takes place in the world of the Maple Springs. Each book is a standalone but best enjoyed together.
